sn32.13-52:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn32.13-52:1.3: “ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā uṇhavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ …pe…
sn32.13-52:1.7: idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati, vācāya sucaritaṃ carati, manasā sucaritaṃ carati.
sn32.13-52:1.11: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā vassavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya”nti.
sn32.13-52:1.12: so annaṃ deti …pe… so pānaṃ deti …pe… so vatthaṃ deti …pe… so yānaṃ deti …pe… so mālaṃ deti …pe… so gandhaṃ deti …pe… so vilepanaṃ deti …pe… so seyyaṃ deti …pe… so āvasathaṃ deti …pe… so
sn32.13-52:1.14: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
sn32.13-52:1.15: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā vassavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
